clause: Generative adapter lane routing + native-fallback separation [STU-VEC-039,STU-VEC-060,STU-VEC-061]

scope.summary: Implement the OPTIONAL generative adapter lane routed through StudioModelAdapter via existing Handshake model routing + provider registry (14.14): Text-to-Vector, Text-to-Pattern, Generative Shape Fill, Generative Recolor, Generative Vectorize, Generative Expand — each clearly marked adapter-backed/optional in UI + command surface, degrading cleanly to the named native primitive or an explicit unavailable state (never a silent no-op), and separable so the vector domain builds/validates/ships with the adapter lane entirely absent; a generative command MUST NOT shadow/replace/silently reroute a native deterministic command, and prompt/style-reference input is governed model input with no implicit network egress.
acceptance_criteria: separable generative lane clearly marked optional + native fallback + no shadowing; builds without adapter; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: generative lane clearly marked adapter-backed/optional via author_id
test: builds+validates with adapter lane absent; unavailable adapter falls back to native primitive or explicit unavailable state (no silent no-op); native command not shadowed

risk_if_missed: Generative lane inseparable / shadows native commands / silent no-op on unavailable adapter.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
